abstract_sentences.text: Metaphorical videos are prevalent across various real-world scenarios to convey complex ideas, and understanding them typically requires high-order cognitive capabilities.

evidence.anchor: Metaphorical videos are prevalent across various real-world scenarios

abstract_sentences.text: The lack of systematic studies on metaphorical video understanding not only constrains the real-world applicability of MLLMs but also impedes the thorough assessment of their high-order cognitive capabilities.
To bridge this gap, we propose MetaphorVU-Bench, the first systematic and comprehensive benchmark dedicated to metaphorical video understanding.
Through experiments, we find current MLLMs struggle with accurate metaphorical video understanding, lagging far behind human level, primarily due to defective cross-domain mapping.

evidence.anchor: primarily due to defective cross-domain mapping

abstract_sentences.text: Motivated by this finding, we construct a metaphor knowledge graph as mapping augmentation and propose MetaphorBoost, an inference-time enhancement framework achieving consistent performance improvement.

evidence.anchor: construct a metaphor knowledge graph as mapping augmentation

abstract_sentences.text: Our benchmark, analysis, and method provide useful insights and a foundation for future research on advancing MLLMs.

evidence.anchor: provide useful insights and a foundation
the core lying in cross-domain mapping
most existing work focuses on literal perception tasks
over 80% of failures do not stem from recognition error
utilizing a metaphorical knowledge graph as external cognitive scaffold
Main contributions of this paper can be summarized as follows

final_judgment.single_storyline: 视频隐喻理解的瓶颈是 visual elements 到 underlying concepts 的 cross-domain mapping；MetaphorVU-Bench 先测量缺口，MetaphorBoost 再以 metaphorical knowledge graph 做推理时映射增强。证据见 p.1–2、p.6–8。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留八类 taxonomy、860 条 benchmark、任务公式(1)、主模型表、四类错误比例、按类型结果、三底座增益、Table 4 消融和 Figure 7 机制图，足以判断方向与规模。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A–H 承载理论出处、过滤/评分/生成 prompt、四个文本数据集、baseline 说明、judge consistency、查询超参数和大量案例；这些内容支撑复现，却增加跨页拼接成本。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 3 的筛选漏斗、Figure 6 的干预流程和公式(1)至(6)把问题、接口、查询和生成对齐；Table 2→Table 3/Figure 5→Table 4/Figure 7 形成缺口、诊断、修复的阅读顺序。
final_judgment.largest_gap: mapping 机制只有人工错误观察、类型差异、消融和 bad-mapping 柱图的间接支持；缺少中间标签、共享分母、seed 方差、成本、独立平台和跨文化测试，因此 consistent/state-of-the-art 只在本文设置内成立。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 高阶能力若依赖可分解中间步骤，应让中间变量拥有实例级测量，并让消融、异质性分析和最终任务分数共享分母与重复运行协议。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 若中间语义没有可靠金标准，应把结果标记为诊断性支持，不能把相关性或 LLM judge 相关写成机制保证。

layout_observations.columns: 正文双栏；p.3 Figure 2 大面积占版，p.4 Figure 3/Table 1/Figure 4 并置，p.5 Table 2 占上半页，p.7 公式与 Figure 6 并置。
layout_observations.appendix_layout: p.19–26 为整页 prompt 图，p.27–34 为每类一页的案例图。
layout_observations.float_effect: 图表和 prompt 图压缩可读正文面积，估计词数排除了重复页眉、页脚和图表可视文字。
